mapper.select: SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, task1_id AS task1Id, task2_id AS task2Id, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM COL_WRITE_USER_ANSWER_RECORD WHERE record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT user.record_id AS recordId, user.user_id AS userId, user.task1_id AS task1Id, user.task2_id AS task2Id, user.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, user.device_type AS deviceType, user.created_at AS createdAt, user.updated_at AS updatedAt, user.total_score AS totalScore, w.COL_TITLE AS title FROM COL_WRITE_USER_ANSWER_RECORD user LEFT JOIN col_writing_task_record w ON user.task1_id = w.task1_id and user.task2_id = w.task2_id WHERE user.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, task1_id AS task1Id, task2_id AS task2Id, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, device_type AS deviceType, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, total_score AS totalScore FROM col_write_user_answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_id = #{recordId}
